_comment: NO NULL ORG (owner ruling 2026-08-21, db-rules FEATURE.md §2/§6e). Seeded from LIVE, not from zero — the gate's job is preventing growth, not forcing an instant cleanup, and it must never be able to block a release on the legacy backlog. `null_org_rows_total` may only go DOWN; `nullable_org_columns` may only SHRINK. Raising either is an Arman decision; agents shrink them with --update-baseline.
_org_less_by_constraint_comment: Tables where a NULL organization_id is not debt but the shape the DATABASE DEMANDS: on each of these `organization_id` is a scope selector, a grant target, or one arm of an XOR ownership union — never an owner column — and a live CHECK constraint enforces exactly that. Stamping an org on these rows raises a check violation; it does not fix anything. Each entry NAMES the constraint it rests on and check-org-null.ts verifies that constraint against the live catalog on EVERY run (via org_constraints from public.org_null_ratchet_snapshot, added by migrations/org_null_ratchet_constraint_evidence.sql). A dropped or renamed constraint makes the exemption SCREAM instead of silently excusing real debt. Established 2026-08-29 after these five tables accounted for 148 of the 175 rows the ratchet was reporting as violations. An entry leaves this list when the table's DESIGN changes, never to quiet a gate.

org_less_by_constraint.reason: organization_id is a SCOPE SELECTOR on a policy ladder, not an owner. The constraint REQUIRES organization_id IS NULL for scope in ('global','taxonomy_node','entity') and NOT NULL only for scope='organization'. The reader platform.resolve_retention_policy compares organization_id solely inside its scope='organization' arm. All 113 live NULL-org rows are scope='entity' (112, seeded by matrx-frontend/migrations/hr_13_governance.sql, one per HR entity token) or scope='global' (1, the floor policy from aidream/db/migrations/0415). There is no client write path at all: RLS is retention_policy_no_write USING(false) WITH CHECK(false).

organization_id is the TARGET of a grant, not the owner of the grant row. The constraint REQUIRES organization_id IS NULL for audience='global' and audience='industry', and NOT NULL only for audience='organization'. public.user_can_read_via_library_grant reads organization_id only under its audience='organization' arm. The grant row's actual owner is the published entity, which library_publish asserts belongs to the Matrx Library system org.

Polymorphic owner. The constraint REQUIRES (owner_type='user' AND owner_user_id NOT NULL AND organization_id IS NULL) OR (owner_type='organization' AND owner_user_id NULL AND organization_id NOT NULL). All 14 NULL-org rows are owner_type='user' personal OAuth connections (google/github); the 3 org-owned rows carry an org. Every writer sets the pair explicitly.

XOR ownership: CHECK ((user_id IS NOT NULL) <> (organization_id IS NOT NULL)) — a personal secret CANNOT carry an org, the DB refuses it. Confirmed from schema, RLS and writers before deciding: policy user_secrets_personal_grantee_read exists specifically to serve rows with organization_id IS NULL, and trigger users.enforce_secret_item_owner_match requires the secret's (user_id, organization_id) pair to match its credential_item's pair with `is not distinct from`, so backfilling an org onto a personal secret would be rejected twice over. All 157 NULL-org rows have user_id set. matrx_orm secrets_battery states it in code: 'PERSONAL (user_id set, organization_id NULL) or ORG-SCOPED (organization_id set, user_id NULL) - never both', enforced in app code by _validate_owner. Personal-by-design, NOT a backfill. Note access_mode='all_members' on personal rows is an inert default, not evidence of org scope; it is only read on the org branch.

XOR ownership: CHECK ((user_id IS NOT NULL) <> (organization_id IS NOT NULL)) — same contract as users.user_secrets, which inherits its scope from the credential item it belongs to. All 72 NULL-org rows are personal credential items with user_id set; the 5 org-owned rows have no user_id. Policy credential_items_personal_grantee_read is keyed on user_id IS NOT NULL and serves exactly these rows. Every writer routes through _validate_owner, which raises unless exactly one of the two is set.
